title: These are 3 small optimization that should reduce the discovery time in remove-package by about 30% (depending on the healthiness of LP this can usually result in improvements from  1.5 to 8 seconds).
description:
These are 3 small optimization that should reduce the discovery time in remove-package by about 30% (depending on the healthiness of LP this can usually result in improvements from  1.5 to 8 seconds).

The fixes in order explained:
- The first commit avoids the architecture loading call for source only remove-package invocations
- The second commit is a workaround for bug 2174677, where indexing an empty collection would result in an extra fetch
- The third commit collapses the two separate getPublishedSources calls for pending and published packages into one, which the getPublishedSources API supports (but not the getPublishedBinaries API)
